mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have clear skies and 47 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park under a New Moon. The overnight low will drop to 39 degrees with no rain predicted overnight.

In city news, Phase 2 of the Mark Drive reconstruction project is progressing between North Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue. Contractors are wrapping up concrete curb, sidewalk, and driveway installation while preparing the roadway for its base layer of asphalt.

Looking at upcoming events, you can play trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus Brewing Co, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Later in the week, check out Trivia Night at The Mill on November 12th or live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard on November 13th.

In the weekly police report, officers responded early Saturday morning to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue regarding a vehicle stopped in the intersection, which led to the arrest of a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I.
Culver's is closed for the night after featuring Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. They will reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM serving Chocolate Heath Crunch as tomorrow's Flavor of the Day.
